authority.owner_words: Windows 11 and ubuntu wsl2 are tested. If it works on other things is unproven, but not disallowed

affected_exit: Clean Windows 10/11 x64, macOS Intel/Apple Silicon and declared Linux x64 DEB/RPM environments satisfy their complete native card criteria.
reading: The Windows environment for this exit is Windows 11 x64 on JaegAW, as a clean non-elevated ordinary-user desktop. The Linux environment is Ubuntu 26.04 x86_64 under WSL2/WSLg on JaegAW, testing the DEB and per-user archive; the 2026-10-11 RFC-BPR-0038 amendment had already removed RPM, Ubuntu 24.04 and RHEL from the selected set. Windows 10 and a separate native Ubuntu desktop are not required. They are unproven but not disallowed, and nothing claims them. macOS is unchanged.
plan_text: Unchanged. milestone-plan.json and the generated MILESTONES.md keep the exit text above verbatim, as owner mandate r4 preserved M1-M11 byte-equivalent. check-amendment cannot change exit text, so the change is recorded here rather than by rewriting the adopted plan.
